title: elephant-1 against the silver labels
compared: elephant-1's most likely class against the class a frontier model gave with hindsight, on all jobs and on the jobs where elephant-1 was most sure.
sample: Failed jobs with a posted LLM comment and a silver class: public pool and internal pool.
verdict: Right on about half the jobs, and on 45 of 46 public jobs where it was very sure.
note: The silver labels are a frontier model's, not a person's. The cut-offs 0.7 and 0.6 are the ones the records used for each pool.
